baslik: Tiglat-pileser I, Hatti kralı Ini-Teššub'a haraç yükledi
metin: Upon my return I became lord of the entire land Hatti (and) imposed upon Ini-Tesub, king of the land Hatti, tax, tribute, and (impost consisting of) cedar beams.

baslik: Tiglat-pileser I'e Milidia boyun eğdi, yıllık kurşun haracı
metin: I marched to the rebellious and insubmissive city Milidia of the land Hanigalbat. Frightened by my strong belligerent attack they submitted to me … I took hostages, I imposed upon them as … uninterrupted annual tribute one homer of lead
harita_degisimi_ozgun: HAYIR (v: ‘annual tribute’ → tâbilik kanıtı; toprak devri yok)

metin: At that time I received a large female monkey (and) a small female monkey, a shipment from the land Blt-Adini which lies on the bank of the Euphrates.
To the city Patiskun [belonging to Ammeba'li], a man of Bit-Zamani, I approached … To save his life he submitted to me … I had him take an oath by Assur, my lord

baslik: Amme-baʾli öldürüldü; Aššurnaṣirpal II İlanu'yu atadı
metin: I flayed Bur-Ramanu, the guilty man … I appointed Ilanu, his brother, to the position of sheikh. I imposed upon him as annual tribute two minas of gold, thirteen minas of silver, 1,000 sheep, (and) 2,000 (measures) of barley.
harita_degisimi_ozgun: EVET (kral atadım → yönetim değişimi; yıllık haraç = v:)

baslik: Damdammusa kalesi alındı, Amedu önüne kafa yığını
metin: I approached the city Damdammusa, the fortified city of Ilanu, a man of Blt-Zamani … I took that city in hand for myself. I took the live soldiers (and) the heads to the city Amedu, his royal city, (and) built a pile of heads before his gate
harita_degisimi_ozgun: SINIR (Damdammusa kalesi DEVİR: ‘took that city in hand for myself’; Amedu yalnız akın)

metin: In the eponymy of Samas-nuri … At that time I received cedar logs, silver, (and) gold, the tribute of Qatazili, the Kummuhu.

baslik: Aššurnaṣirpal II Kunulua'ya geldi; Lubarna boyun eğdi
metin: I approached the city Kunulua, the royal city of Lubarna, the Patinu. He took fright … and submitted to me to save his life. I received as his tribute 20 talents of silver, one talent of gold …

baslik: Aribua kalesi Asur'a geçti, Asurlu iskânı
metin: I entered the city Aribua, the fortified city of Lubarna, the Patinu, (and) took the city in hand for myself … I settled people of Assyria in (the city).

baslik: Şalmaneser III, Sapalulme koalisyonunu (Patina, Bīt-Adini, Karkamış, Samʾal, Que, Ḫilakku) dağıttı
metin: Sapalulme, the Patinean, [received] into [his] armed forces Ahunu, the man of Bit-Adini, Sangara, the Carchemishite, [Ha]iianu, the Safm^alite], Kate (Katia), the Quean, Pihirim, the Hilukean, Bur-Anate, the Iasbuqean, (and) Adanu, the Iahanean. By the command of Assur, my lord, (70') I scattered their assembled forces.

baslik: Lutibu önünde Samʾal'li Haiianu ile savaş
metin: I approached the city Lutibu, the fortified city of Haiianu, the Sam'alite. Haiianu, the Sam'alite, Sapalulme, the Patinean … prepared for war. They attacked me

baslik: Til-Barsip önünde Ahunu yenildi, kentine kapatıldı
metin: I approached the city Til-Barsip, the fortified city of Ahunu, the man of Blt-Adini … I fought with him (and) defeated him. I confined him to his city.
I approached the cities of Mutallu, the Gurgumite. I received tribute from Mutallu, the Gurgumite: silver, gold, oxen, sheep, wine, (and) his daughter with her rich dowry.

I received from Sangara, the Carchemishite, two talents of gold, seventy talents of silver … I imposed upon him as tribute one mina of gold, one talent of silver, (and) two talents of red purple wool, (and) I receive (it) annually.

I received from Qalparunda, the Patinean, three talents of gold, 100 talents of silver … I imposed upon him as annual tribute one talent of silver, two talents of red purple wool, (and) 100 cedar beams, (and) I regularly receive (it) in my city, Assur.

I received from yaiianu, the man of Blt-Gabbari, which is at the foot of the Amanus range … I imposed upon him as tribute ten minas of silver, 100 cedar beams, (and) one homer of cedar resin, (and) I receive (it) annually in my city, Assur.
From Qatazilu, the Kummuhite, I receive annually twenty minas of silver (and) 300 cedar beams.

baslik: Til-Barsip ilhak edildi, Kār-Šalmaneser adı verildi
metin: in the eponymy of Assur-bela-ka^in … I seized the cities TIl-Barsip, Alligu, [Nappigu], (and) Rugulitu as my royal cities. I settled therein Assyrians (and) founded inside palaces as my royal residences. I renamed TIl-Barsip as Kar-Shalmaneser
harita_degisimi_ozgun: EVET (DEVİR: ‘seized … as my royal cities. I settled therein Assyrians’)

baslik: Ahunu Šitamrat dağında ele geçirildi; Bīt-Adini sona erdi
metin: In a second year, the eponymy of Assur-bunaiia-usur, I went after him … I took as my own Ahunu with his troops, chariots, cavalry … and brought (it) to my city, Assur. I regarded them as people of my land.
harita_degisimi_ozgun: EVET (DEVİR: ‘regarded them as people of my land’)

baslik: Pitru'da Melidli Lalla, Gurgumlu Qalparuda vd.'den haraç
metin: I received tribute from kings on the opposite bank of the Euphrates, from Sangara the Carchemishite, from Kundaspu the Kummuhite, from Aramu, the man of BIt-Agusi, from Lalla the Melidite, from Haiianu the man of BTt-Gahbari, from Qalparuda the Patinean, (and) from Qalparuda the Gurgumite

baslik: Şalmaneser III Que'ye indi, kentlerini yağmaladı
metin: In my twentieth regnal year I crossed the Euphrates for the twentieth time (and) went down to the land Que (Qau). I captured their cities (and) plundered them. || (839 BC) [Šulmu-bēli-lāmur] [governor of Arzuḫina] [to Qu]e.

baslik: Tabal seferi: Tuatti'nin kentleri yakıldı, Kikki boyun eğdi, 20 kral hediye
metin: I crossed Mount Timur (and) went down to the cities of Tuatti, the Tabalite. I razed, destroyed, (and) burned their cities … I surrounded Artulu, his royal city. Kikki, his son, was afraid to fight and submitted to me. (170') I received tribute from him. I received gifts from twenty kings of the land Tabal. || (836 BC) … Raqmat to Tabal.
Moving on from Mount Tunni, I went down to the cities of Puhame, the IJubusnean (Hubuskaean), (and) approached the city Hubusnu, his royal [city]. I received the tribute of [...]

baslik: Lalla'nın Uetaš kalesi ele geçirildi; Tabal kralları haraç verdi
metin: In my twenty-third regnal year I crossed the Euphrates (and) captured Uetas, the fortified city of Lalla, the Melidite. The kings of the land Tabal came to me (and) I received their tribute. || (835 BC) … Ḫabrūri to Melid.

kesinlik: orta (BO 26. yıl; kronik 832 ve 831 ‘to Que’ — RlA: uyuşmazlık)
baslik: Kate'nin yerine kardeşi Kirri tahta çıkarıldı
metin: I marched for a fourth time to the cities of Kate, the Quean (Qau). I surrounded Tanakun, the fortified city of Tullu … city Tarsus. (The people) submitted to me (and) I received tribute from them of silver (and) gold. I appointed Kirn, the brother of Kate, as sovereign over them.

baslik: Lubarna öldürüldü, gaspçı Surri; Asur Sasi'yi atadı
metin: the people of the land Patinu had killed Lubarna, their lord, (and) appointed Surri, a non-royal person … Sasi, a man of the land Kurussa, submitted to him (and) he appointed (him) to sovereignty over them … He created my colossal royal statue (and) erected (it) in Kinalua

metin: When Uspilulume, king of the Kummuhites, caused Adad-narari, king of Assyria, (and) Semiramis … to cross the Euphrates … they erected this boundary stone between Uspilulume, king of the Kummuhites, and Qalparuda … king of the Gurgumites.
On my return (from Damascus) I gave this boundary stone to Uspilulume, king of the Kummuhites.

baslik: TP III, Sarduri koalisyonunu (Melidli Sulumal, Gurgumlu Tarḫulara) yendi
metin: [In] my [third palû …] … [Sulumal of the land Mel]id, Tarḫu-lara of [the land Gurgu]m … in all lands, [they trusted] in one another’s strength … I killed their [warriors] (and) I filled the mountain gorges with them

metin: [Sulumal of the land Mel]id, Tarḫu-lara of [the land Gurgu]m … I killed their [warriors]

baslik: Kullani alındı; Unqi Asur eyaleti oldu
metin: [Tutammû, king of the land Unqi], neglected [the loyalty oath …] … I captured the city Kinalia (Kunalua), his royal city … I reorganized [the city] Kinalia (Kunalua), s[ubdued] the land Unqi to its full extent, [...], (and) placed [... eunuchs of] mine as provincial governors over them. || (738 BC) Kullani captured.

baslik: Uassurme tahttan indirildi, Ḫulli tahta oturtuldu
metin: [U]assurme of the land Tabal acted as if he were the equal of Assyria and he did not come before me. [I sent] a eunuch of mine, the chief [eunuch, to the land Tabal …]. I placed [Ḫu]llî, a commoner (lit. “son of a nobody”) on his royal throne.

baslik: Šinuḫtu'lu Kiakki sürüldü, kent Atuna'lı Kurti'ye verildi
metin: In my fourth regnal year, Kiakki of the city Šinuḫtu disregarded the treaty … overwhelmed his royal city Šinuḫtu like a fog, and counted him as booty … I gave his royal city Šinuḫtu to Kurtî of the land Atuna.
harita_degisimi_ozgun: EVET (DEVİR → atuna: ‘I gave his royal city’)

metin: I gave his royal city Šinuḫtu to Kurtî of the land Atuna. Then, I made larger than before (the number/amount of) horses, mules, gold, (and) silver (that he had to pay as tribute) and I imposed (this) upon him.

baslik: Pisiri sürüldü; Karkamış'a Asurlular iskân edildi
metin: In my fifth regnal year, Pisīri(s) the city Carchemish sinned against the treaty … I settled people of Assyria in the city Carchemish and imposed the yoke of the god Aššur, my lord, upon them.

baslik: Mita'nın aldığı Que kaleleri Ḫarrua ve Ušnanis geri verildi
metin: For a second time, I brought about [the def]eat of Mitâ, king of the land Musku, in his (own) wide district and I (then) restored to their former status the cities Ḫarrua (and) Ušnanis, fortresses of the land Que (Cilicia) that he had taken away by force in the distant past.

I took Amris (Ambaris) to Assyria, (along) with (his) family, (his) relatives … (along) with one hundred of his chariots. I settled there Assyrians who respect my authority. I set a eunuch of mine as provincial governor over them

kesinlik: düşük (ÜST; ‘In the time of Ḫullî’, 720–713; RlA iddiayı ‘hollow’ sayar)
baslik: Ḫilakku, Ambaris'e çeyiz olarak verildi (Asur iddiası)
metin: I gave to Amris (Ambaris) of the land Tabal, whom I had seated upon the throne of his father Ḫullî, a daughter of mine, (along) with the land Ḫilakku, which had not been part of his ancestors’ territory, and I (thus) expanded his land.

baslik: Tarḫunazi sürüldü; Melid kenti Kummuh'a, Kammanu eyalet
metin: I smashed h[is] royal city Melid like a pot … I g[ave] his (Tarḫun-azi’s) royal city [Meli]d, as well as the district [in its environs, (...) to] Mut[al]lu of the land Kummuḫu.
harita_degisimi_ozgun: EVET (DEVİR: Melid → kummuh; Kammanu → Asur eyaleti)

baslik: Kummuh, Melid kentini ve çevresini aldı
metin: I g[ave] his (Tarḫun-azi’s) royal city [Meli]d, as well as the district [in its environs, (...) to] Mut[al]lu of the land Kummuḫu.

I counted his heir Mutallu as booty, together with the (ruling) family of the land Bīt-Paʾalla … I set a eunuch of mine as provincial governor over them and considered them as people of Assyria. || (711 BC) Against the city Marqasa.

baslik: Que valisi Mita topraklarına üç kez akın etti (Que eyalet tanığı)
metin: While I was bringing about the defeat of the land Bīt-Yakīn … a eunuch of mine, the governor of the land Que (Cilicia), marched … three times into the territory of Mitâ (Midas) of the land Musku. He destroyed, demolished, (and) burned down his cities with fire.
harita_degisimi_ozgun: HAYIR (Que zaten Asur eyaleti — statü tanığı; Musku'ya AKIN)

metin: The city Kummuḫu was captured; a provincial governor was appointed.

metin: ALINTI (Hdt 6.18): "they utterly captured it in the sixth year after the revolt of Aristagoras. They enslaved the city". ALINTI (Iranica): "Miletus still held out, but inevitably fell after some months (494) ... The city and its territory were settled by Persians and Carians." (iskân ⇒ DEVİR)
tarih_turu_ozgun: ② SINIR (Hdt 'altıncı yıl' göreli + edebî mutlak)

baslik: Ayaklanmanın bastırılması; İyonya 'üçüncü kez köleleştirildi'; Artaphernes düzenlemesi
metin: ALINTI (Hdt 6.32): "Thus three times had the Ionians been enslaved, first by the Lydians and now twice in a row by the Persians." ALINTI (Iranica): "During 493 Artaphernes began the task of pacification ... he based the tribute imposed on them on the survey".

ALINTI (Hdt 7.98): "from Cilicia, Syennesis son of Oromedon; from Lycia, Cyberniscus son of Sicas ... and from Caria, Histiaeus son of Tymnes, Pigres son of Hysseldomus, and Damasithymus son of Candaules." (Pers ordusuna asker = tâbilik kanıtı)
tarih_turu_ozgun: ② SINIR (480 Kserkses seferi edebî tarih)

baslik: Syennesis III Genç Kyros'u destekledi; ardından Kilikya olağan satraplık
metin: ALINTI (Livius): "in 401, the couple supported the revolt of Cyrus the Younger against his brother Artaxerxes II Mnemon ... After 400, it became a normal satrapy." Iranica CARIA: "Artaxerxes, when he removed native loyalty from the position of satrap in Cilicia (the Syennesis)".

ALINTI (Iranica CARIA): "Hecatomnus ca. 392/1-d. 377/6"; "Caria as a separate satrapy under the Hecatomnid family, 390s-30s". Britannica: "Early in the 4th century bce all of Caria was rejoined to Persia’s Achaemenian Empire as a separate satrapy under the rule of the native Hecatomnid dynasty ."
ALINTI (Britannica CARIA): "Mausolus (c. 377–353 bce ), transferred the capital from Mylasa to Halicarnassus".

baslik: Granikos savaşı — Batı Anadolu Ahameniş savunmasının çöküşü (K4/K5 olayı)
metin: ALINTI (Britannica): "Battle of Granicus , (May 334 bce ). The first victorious engagement of Alexander the Great ’s invasion of the Persian Empire ... The victory left Asia Minor wide open to the Macedonian invasion."

baslik: Sardes İskender'e teslim (Mithrines); Lidyalılara 'eski Lidya yasaları'
metin: ALINTI (Arrian 1.17): "he was met by Mithrines, the commandant of the garrison in the Acropolis, accompanied by the most influential of the citizens of Sardis. The latter surrendered the city into his hands, and Mithrines the fortress and the money laid up in it ... granted the Sardians and other Lydians the privilege of enjoying the ancient laws of Lydia, and permitted them to be free."
ALINTI (Arrian 1.19): "As soon as Alexander had got possession of the city, he sailed against those who had fled". Britannica: "it fell to Alexander in 334 after a siege".

baslik: Halikarnassos düştü; Orontopates kaçtı; Ada Karya'ya atandı — Ahameniş Karya sonu
metin: ALINTI (Iranica CARIA): "Fall of Achaemenid Caria, 334-33 b.c. ... Halicarnassus and its environs did not fall until the end of 333, Orontopates fleeing east to fight at Gaugamela". ALINTI (Arrian 1.23): "He appointed Ada to act as his viceroy of the whole of Caria."

ALINTI (Arrian 1.24): "Then he invaded Lycia and brought over the Telmissians by capitulation; and crossing the river Xanthus, the cities of Pinara, Xanthus, Patara, and about thirty other smaller towns were surrendered to him."
ALINTI (Penn): "When Alexander the Great of Macedon began his world-altering campaign against the Persian Empire in 334 BCE, he came to Gordion in that first year and may have wintered there."
